test_title: PYST 29: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following three letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different.

Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and second letter - Difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (1).
 
• Second and third letter - Difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (2).

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : ONL

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/268a4e8418a0d302a05253380e1f34120fb223ae7bac7d6774ec8f8dcf7de018.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : RQO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6d107d7379eb721c9d604973c434ffa118b20af2ddff9ecc3ad5baaaf400ecd.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : HGE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/919e91614ab895d376c4032366e5937b741630cf8c9435e34edf0c990fc09672.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : DCB

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18bc727d8c54ee78a4a8678969a39612fb325d55e851fb8b837c6df0828da7b2.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'DCB' is the odd one out as the difference between first and the second letter and second and third letter are (1) and (1) respectively.

​Hence, "DCB" is the correct answer.
